corporate_pages.spacing: Generous (p-8 to p-24) to create a clinical, airy feel. Use Swiss Grid for section layout.
corporate_pages.hero: Max overlay bg-black/40 to let lab/pharma images breathe. Avoid heavy gradients.
corporate_pages.sections: Alternate between bg-white and bg-[#F4F7F5] to separate content gracefully.

b2b_ecommerce.cart_table: High density grid. Compact spacing for B2B ordering (Pack, Qty, Scheme, Free Qty, Dispatch Qty).
b2b_ecommerce.mobile: Bottom navigation bar (fixed, z-50, backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-t border-gray-200) with icons for Home, Products, Search, Cart, Account, WhatsApp Order.

admin_dashboard.style: High-density grid (Mode B Bento), compact padding.
admin_dashboard.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, bg-[#022B18] text-white for authoritative admin feel, or pure white with green active states.

glassmorphism.usage: Use ONLY for sticky headers, mobile bottom nav, and modal overlays.

icons.style: Clean, clinical line icons. Stroke width 1.5 or 2.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on hero backgrounds for depth.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalistic. Use micro-interactions for button hovers (bg color shift) and standard dialog entrances (fade/scale). NO excessive animations.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders for a structured, medical look. No heavy shadows.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Dark pine text on white meets this easily.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='whatsapp-login-btn').

media.treatment: High quality photography. Use bg-black/40 overlay for text contrast on hero banners. No generic 3D cartoons. Clear, white-background product shots for catalog items.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components (.jsx) but customize them to match the B2B medical aesthetic (flat, crisp 1px borders, minimal shadow, Vetmech Green focus rings).
For the B2B Cart Table, implement dense grids with explicit columns for Scheme, Free Qty, and Dispatch Qty as requested.
Implement a Mobile Bottom Nav bar (fixed bottom, z-50) with Home, Products, Search, Cart, Account, WhatsApp Order. Hide it on desktop screens (md:hidden).
WhatsApp OTP Modal must use Shadcn Dialog for a clean, distraction-free centralized login.
Do NOT use HTML native datepickers or selects. Use Shadcn Dropdown, Select, and Calendar.
Ensure the Admin panel is completely isolated with its own layout (Sidebar + Header + Content Area) using the high-density grid approach.
Avoid the generic 'Vercel SaaS' look. This is a B2B veterinary pharma site. Use the designated 'Vetmech Forest Green' (#045D3A) as the primary brand color.
DO NOT apply global transitions like 'transition: all' in CSS.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., Add to cart success, WhatsApp OTP sent). Ensure sonner is installed.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid excessive soft shadows. Rely on crisp borders instead.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (e.g., 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or .js
